title: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Nic Salt blends the rich body of Tobacco with smooth Vanilla and the roasted depth of Cappuccino. The Tobacco note provides a firm base, softened by mellow Vanilla sweetness, while Cappuccino adds a warm coffee character for a rounded finish. Made with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a smoother throat hit, this 50VG/50PG blend is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices and vape pens. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Vanilla Cappuccino Tobacco Nic Salt offers a layered, satisfying option for vapers who enjoy Tobacco with a sweet and aromatic twist.
